lesson-intro.text: Wizards turn it over to count the minutes, and the sand never hurries. It's two slabs at each end, a pinched glass and two posts. Watch the sand fall, then turn over your own.

base.text: The hourglass stands on two slabs. A wide one with rounded ends, then a narrower one on top.

glass.text: The glass rises from the middle. Curve each side in to a narrow waist and out again.

top.text: The same two slabs cap the top: the narrow one on the glass, the wide one above it.

posts.text: Two posts stand between the wide slabs. Each edge bulges out three times, like beads on a string.

sand-top.text: Sand fills the bottom of the upper bulb. Draw its level top, then a short line across the waist.

sand-fall.text: A thin line of sand falls from the waist onto a soft heap below.

wood.text: Color the wide slabs brown and the narrow ones orange.

sand-color.text: Color the sand yellow, top and bottom.

lesson-outro.text: Time is running out, one grain at a time. Better start your next drawing before it empties.
